## Why it's here

The Control Plane repo's Kiro-native skill at `.kiro/skills/diagram-design/SKILL.md`
adapts and points into this material. This mirror is the full reference bundle:

| Folder | Files | Purpose |
|--------|-------|---------|
| `SKILL.md` | 1 | Upstream skill definition (entry point of original skill) |
| `assets/` | 162 | Rendered diagram examples + HTML templates + icon library |
| `references/` | 56 | Per-diagram-type specs, style guide, semantic patterns, profiles |
| `scripts/` | 4 | Import extractors (drawio/excalidraw/mermaid) + self-check validator |

## Modifications

None. Files in this directory are unmodified from upstream. Do not edit files here —
if adaptation is needed, do it in the Kiro-native skill files one level up
(`.kiro/skills/diagram-design/SKILL.md` and `.kiro/skills/diagram-design/references/`).
